## Technical Architecture & Core Stacks

### 1. Artificial Intelligence & Deep Learning
- Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, TensorRT, ONNX Runtime, OpenCV
- Computer Vision: YOLOv8, YOLOv9 instance segmentation & object classification
- Latency Benchmark: <14ms edge inference speed on NVIDIA Jetson AGX / Orin platforms
- Accuracy Metrics: 99.8% precision on industrial inspection datasets

### 2. Large Language Models & Agentic AI
- Agent Orchestration: LangGraph (StateGraph workflows), LangChain, LlamaIndex
- Inference Providers: Groq (ultra-low latency LLaMA 3.3 70B & 8B), OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude
- Search & Retrieval: Dual-engine Tavily / DuckDuckGo web search routing, FAISS & Qdrant vector retrieval
- Patterns: Human-in-the-loop (HITL) interrupt states, persistent thread checkpointers, self-healing reflection loops

### 3. Full-Stack Web & Mobile Architecture
- Frontend: React 18, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TypeScript
- Mobile: Flutter (Dart), React Native, Kotlin Android Native daemons
- Backend APIs: Django REST Framework, FastAPI (Python 3.11+), Node.js / Express
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Redis (in-memory caching & session stores), MongoDB, SQLite
- Cloud & CI/CD: Docker containers, Vercel, AWS ECS / Lambda, GitHub Actions, NGINX

### 4. Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
- Analysis Frameworks: Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy), Microsoft Excel (dynamic pivot tables & macros), SQL (PostgreSQL & MySQL aggregations)
- Machine Learning Models: XGBoost, LightGBM, Random Forest, SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) for explainability
- Visualization: Chart.js, Recharts, Matplotlib, Seaborn

## Deep Dive into Verified Deployments

### A. Noesis — Autonomous AI Study Assistant
- Link: https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/noesis
- Core Problem: Students and researchers struggle with passive reading and non-interactive study material.
- Architecture: LangGraph multi-agent DAG that analyzes topic difficulty, queries web search APIs, synthesizes organized Markdown notes, and constructs calibrated multi-choice quizzes.
- Key Feature: Human-in-the-Loop calibration allowing users to approve/adjust search queries before notes generation.

### B. The Watcher — AI Child Safety Platform
- Link: https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/the-watcher
- Core Problem: Traditional parental blockers are intrusive and easily bypassed.
- Architecture: On-device Kotlin daemon + Flutter UI communicating with a Django REST & LangGraph backend. Real-time classification of browsing patterns without logging sensitive personal data.
- Key Feature: AI-generated daily risk digest summarizing anomalies in plain English.

### C. FrontDesk AI — Autonomous WhatsApp Booking Agent
- Link: https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/frontdesk-ai
- Core Problem: Medical clinics and service businesses lose customers due to delayed front-desk messaging response times.
- Architecture: Webhook integration via Twilio WhatsApp Business API -> Django async processor -> Groq-accelerated LangGraph scheduling agent -> Google Calendar / internal DB sync.
- Key Feature: Natural bilingual fluency across conversational Roman Urdu and English.

### D. ThreadEye — Industrial Fabric Defect Detection
- Link: https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/threadeye
- Core Problem: Manual textile inspection misses 15-20% of warp/weft defects at high loom speeds.
- Architecture: 4K industrial line-scan cameras streaming 60 FPS video over GigE to NVIDIA Jetson hardware running YOLOv8n-seg TensorRT engine. Flaws trigger instant PLC relays.
- Key Feature: Sub-14ms detection latency with 99.8% classification accuracy.

### E. GetScry — Real-Time Visitor Intent Intelligence
- Link: https://brixellabs.com/case-studies/getscry
- Core Problem: High bounce rates and wasted marketing discounts given to low-intent shoppers.
- Architecture: High-throughput event ingestion -> XGBoost classifier predicting purchase intent (0-100%) -> SHAP explainability engine generating human-readable conversion reasons in <35ms.
